lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: Mages. You act like knowledge is a sword. It's more like a lockpick.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: A lockpick opens a door. A sword ends an argument.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: And here I am, carrying both.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: You know things you shouldn't. About the Veil's inner cells.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: For a rogue, maybe. For a scholar, it's a liability.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: How does it feel to hold fire in your hands?

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: Like being trusted with something that doesn't forgive mistakes.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: You actually read my Rift notes.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: I read everything I can reach. Was it in reach? Then I read it.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: If the Rift is real — if it's actually pulling things through — why study it instead of closing it?

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: Because you can't close what you don't understand. And so far, no one understands it.
